lamppost · gap-aware Chamfer

Accuracy / Completeness / F1 (reference-gap-aware)

Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. The DBSCAN gap tuner below is a live gap-exclusion tuner that updates the Accuracy/Completeness/F1 panels further down as soon as any slider changes.
vggt fails on this lamppost. flashlight_004 is a thin, tall lamppost (~6 m). mast3r_ga, colmap and hloc_colmap reconstructed it cleanly (accuracy median ~1-3.5 cm), while vggt produced a blurred noise cloud (median ~11 cm). Its points are far from the surface — this is real reconstruction noise, not a reference gap, so DBSCAN gap-exclusion on vggt can spuriously “improve” F1; comparing methods via vggt on this object is not valid.

Reference (LiDAR) — NN-spacing distribution

Distance from every point of the cleaned reference to its nearest neighbour in the same cloud — the very spacing from which the voxel/radius for density-matching is derived (radius = 3× median).

DBSCAN gap tuner

Controls which reconstruction points "far from the reference" are treated as a confirmed gap (excluded) vs. a single outlier (kept and penalised). Move any slider and the exclusion is recomputed for all methods, and the Accuracy/Completeness/F1 panels below update: both the cloud colouring and accuracy%/F1.
When enabled, no far point is excluded as a “gap”: accuracy/F1 are computed over the whole cloud. this lamppost has no gaps, so this is the honest mode (and it does not let vggt spuriously “improve” by cutting away its noise).

Accuracy / Completeness / F1 — gap-excluded (reactive to the tuner above), adjustable threshold t

Pipeline: aligned → density-matched (voxel = median NN-spacing of the reference) → gap-exclusion by the current tuner parameters above (only clusters are excluded; single outliers are kept and penalised). Accuracy%/F1 are recomputed exactly (a population-weighted estimate over the true sizes of the "below floor"/ "candidates" groups, since the two were subsampled at different rates — see the code). Completeness% is computed once against the FULL (non-excluded) reconstruction cloud and does not depend on the tuner — mathematically exact for t ≤ far_threshold (for "good" target points the nearest neighbour physically cannot be an excludable gap point, since gap points are by construction farther than far_threshold from ANY target point); for t above far_threshold completeness may be slightly optimistic.
